root_cause.text: The verify_dfa() function in the AppArmor subsystem omits bounds validation for DEFAULT_TABLE entries when the MATCH_FLAG_DIFF_ENCODE flag is set, allowing malformed DFAs to trigger out-of-bounds memory access.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the `!(BASE_TABLE(dfa)[i] & MATCH_FLAG_DIFF_ENCODE)` condition from the bounds check `if (DEFAULT_TABLE(dfa)[i] >= state_count)`, addressing the CVE description which states the function only checked DEFAULT_TABLE bounds when the state was not differentially encoded.
